children: ChronoScale announced that Scott Davis resigned from its board effective October 3, 2026, in connection with the sale of Ekso and received vested RSUs and a lump-sum cash payment.
In connection with the sale of Ekso (Transaction)
Served as CEO of Ekso; granted 51,626 RSUs that fully vested on grant date (Oct 2, 2026)
Lump sum Release Payment of $709,500 (payable within 30 days of execution), subject to withholding and compliance with Release Agreement
Entered into Release Agreement providing general release of claims; Release Agreement does not amend Phantom Performance-Based RSU Agreement dated Nov 5, 2025

title: ChronoScale's Scott Davis resigns from board after Ekso sale; receives RSUs and $709,500 payment
